tips.text: Slot three different Antivirus mods at once; you find the right one in at most three encounters.
Run Immuno Shield and Instant Secure (+15% each) until you are close, then swap in the side-bonus Potency mods.
Hunt Duets solo, then bring a full squad to the Concert; each extra Coda beaten adds a Heartcell.
Abort right after a correct-Antivirus stab; the disinfection banks immediately.
Hunt the Duet inside the Antivirus Bounty so one run pays Hex standing, Antivirus mods and disinfection.
Bring an invulnerable or overguard frame (Revenant, Nyx, Dante) to the Concert; the stage hazards and the Coda's Toxin ignore shields.
Rush Exterminate nodes first, then Legacyte, and bring a fast-killing frame.
Kill DJ RoM first in any Duet; his Toxin hits skip shields.
Pick Potency mods so your last stab lands on 100%; a mission can never finish the last 5%.
Wait for the Heartcells in your inbox after the vanquish; relog if they are missing.
Bank Heartcells and wait for a high-percentage Caustacyst rather than buying a low roll and fusing repeatedly.
Expect a few hours per Coda; players call it the least painful adversary system, with Eleanor's rotation as the real wait.
Run the Antivirus Bounty on Steel Path for extra standing.
